stemMd: For N2(g) + 3 H2(g) ⇌ 2 NH3(g), increasing pressure by reducing volume at constant temperature favours which direction?

options.label: C
options.textMd: Conversion of nitrogen atoms into hydrogen atoms

options.label: E
options.textMd: Neither direction because gas amounts are equal on both sides

explanationMd: Compression favours the side with fewer gaseous molecules. The product side has two gaseous moles per stoichiometric event versus four on the reactant side, so ammonia formation is favoured.

distractorRationale.e: There are four gas moles on the left and two on the right.
distractorRationale.b: This side contains more gas moles.
distractorRationale.a: No catalyst is specified or destroyed by this principle.
distractorRationale.c: Chemical equilibrium does not change element identity.
